assertions.name: phase_roundtrip_reproduces_c3
assertions.source: cos(Φ_1 u+Φ_2 u²) reproduces c_3 to 1.67e-06 ppm.

description: Reframe the Q_β c_k ladder as the u-Taylor expansion of cos(Φ(u)) (cosh of an imaginary fibre phase), the structure PR #1871 §3 derived (m_avg=m₀cosh θ / Δ_pn=m₀sinh θ). c_2=-1 (proved) ⇒ Φ_1=√2 anchor-exact; c_3=-Φ_1·Φ_2 ⇒ Φ_2=-c_3/√2. Extracts the concrete Φ_2(q) targets at both anchors that #1871's fibre-level q-difference recurrence must reproduce — the closure test for the axis #1880 showed is data-blocked at the c_k level. Unifies #1866 (even cos slice), #1880 (c_3=g), #1887 (sinh parity), #1871 (cosh/sinh series + q-difference). No fits — algebraic read-off.

data.interpretation: The cosh/sinh series structure (PR #1871) is the correct framing for the c_k: they are u-Taylor coefficients of cos(Φ(u)). c_2=-1 fixes Φ_1=√2 (anchor-exact); the open coefficient Φ_2(q)=-c_3(q)/√2 is the concrete target a fibre-level q-difference recurrence must predict at both anchors. This relocates the open question from the (data-blocked, #1880) c_k level to the Φ/recurrence level (#1871's G-equation).
